messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts from Dedicated cluster eu-west-2 - tenant deltaflow. Avg 5xx rate 18% over last 5m. Incident priority: P1
Maya: seeing the page, pulling logs now. Any customer contact yet?
Jordan: I can take lead on runtime debugging, Maya can do customer comms.
Maya: @Eli (DeltaFlow) I left a DM asking for impact details, will update.
Eli (DeltaFlow): Hey, we started getting 502s around 09:12UTC, some requests never stream back. About 25% of calls fail for heavy-context prompts. We're seeing retries from our side.
Sam: logs show repeated "connection reset by peer" in gateway and a surge of inflight batching for model xlarge-v2 on node pool dedicated-eu-02.
Priya: metrics: GPU utilization on dedicated-eu-02 at 96% and queue length spiked to 420 (baseline 30). KV cache misses up 3x.
eng-runtime-lead: possible noisy tenant or a runaway batch size. Any top callers with long seq-lens?
Jordan: query trace aggregator shows a single tenant id with very long sequence lengths and streaming kept-open requests. pattern: many small concurrent streams + occasional 1-minute streaming calls that hold the worker.
Maya: Eli, can you confirm if DeltaFlow sent a recent rollout that might cause long-hanging streams?
Eli (DeltaFlow): We did a canary yesterday that streams contexts for real-time chat. Nothing intentional to cause this but traffic did spike due to a marketing campaign.
Sam: reproducer from logs:
```
2026-03-15T09:11:42Z gateway: conn reset for req 0x7f4a
runtime: batch_wait timeout triggered, worker pinned for 53s
worker: kv-cache evict: sha256~... size 1.2GB
```
Jordan: hypothesis: bursting streaming + large token windows causing long-lived KV caches, preventing scheduling and causing other tenants to queue and timeout -> 502/504.
Priya: Customer impact: DeltaFlow saw 25% failed requests; other tenants on pool saw 4-7% elevated 5xx. Need mitigation ASAP.
Maya: immediate mitigation options: 1) throttle DeltaFlow concurrency on gateway, 2) route DeltaFlow to burst pool (if capacity), 3) evict heavy sessions for tenant and restart worker, 4) temporary per-tenant batch cap. Which do we prefer?
eng-runtime-lead: prefer less disruptive first: apply per-tenant concurrency cap + prefer latency scheduling (disable batch-wait for their sessions). If still bad, evict long sessions and move to burst pool.
infra-oncall: I can spin up one extra node in eu-west-2 burst pool, but provisioning ~4-6m.
Jordan: I'll push gateway throttle rule: `throttle.tenant=deltaflow concurrency=12` and set `batch_wait_ms=0` override for that tenant.
Sam: applying config now to gateway and scheduler...
Maya: alerting DeltaFlow via DM and email that we're throttling concurrency to stabilize.
IncidentBot: Change applied by Jordan at 09:18UTC: throttle rule added. Scheduler override: batch_wait_ms=0 for tenant deltaflow.
Sam: seeing inflight queue drop from 420 -> 160 in 90s. GPU util drops to 78%. 5xx rate trending down to 8% in last 2m.
Eli (DeltaFlow): Thanks — failures dropping. We're still seeing occasional timeouts but much better. Any ETA on full recovery?
eng-runtime-lead: monitor for 10-15m. If errors <2% and latency stable, we can consider reverting throttle partially. Also recommend DeltaFlow reduce streaming window or lower token window as a long-term fix.
Maya: sending official update to DeltaFlow and support ticket opened: INC-3812345678.
Jordan: follow-up actions: 1) add tenant-level long-stream detection alert (>=30s streams), 2) autoscale policy tweak to allow faster burst pool spin-up, 3) investigate KV cache eviction heuristics to avoid single tenant evicting whole node.
Priya: I'll file the runbook PR for tenant throttles and schedule a post-incident review.
infra-oncall: spun up 1 extra burst node, it's healthy and accepting routes. No further evictions observed.
Sam: final metrics snapshot: 5xx down to 1.8% across cluster, DeltaFlow success 98.6%.
Maya: handing off to on-call from day shift for follow-up, Jordan and eng-runtime-lead will be on-call for the next hour if we need fast revert.
ops: noted for customer billing impact window 09:11-09:24UTC.
Eli (DeltaFlow): appreciate the quick response — we'll throttle our side and work on client retry/backoff. Thank you. :bow: 
Maya: incident moving to monitoring state. Postmortem owner: Priya.
IncidentBot: Incident INC-3812345678 status changed to monitoring at 09:30UTC.
